notes: Self-contained WebGL flight exploration game with procedural low-poly archipelago geometry, momentum-based 3D flight, spatial gate crossings, six collectible signal fragments, updraft volumes, collision, synthesized ambient and reactive audio, HUD, pause/restart, keyboard/mouse/touch input and a completion state. No external runtime dependencies. Browser rendering and real-device performance profiling could not be verified because the available headless Chromium environment could not initialize WebGL; JavaScript syntax, metadata validation and mocked WebGL startup/render checks passed.
